villageHistory.heroDescription: A Symbol of Unity and a Home of Development
villageHistory.introDescription: Sategaon, located in Anjangaon Surji Taluka, is a scenic and progressive village. Its residents are known for their hardworking nature and social harmony. The village has embraced modernity while preserving its traditional heritage.
villageHistory.backgroundEyebrow: 📜 History and Origin of the Name
villageHistory.backgroundTitle: History and Origin of the Name
villageHistory.backgroundDescription: The name 'Sategaon' has a deep meaning. The word 'Sate' is associated with 'Saat' (Seven) or 'Saath' (Company/Unity).
villageHistory.backgroundCardDescription: It is believed that seven small settlements existed in this region in the past. These settlements came together to form a larger village, which may be why it was named 'Sategaon' (a group of seven villages). It is also known as a village that stands together and supports everyone.

community.label: 🚩 Village Deity and Culture
community.title: Village Deity and Culture
community.description: Shri Hanuman and Shri Sant Gajanan Maharaj are the village deities, and their temples are places of faith for the villagers. Festivals: Hanuman Jayanti and Ganeshotsav are celebrated here with great enthusiasm. Tradition: The village has a strong Warkari tradition, with regular bhajans and the chanting of God's name.

agriculture.label: 🌾 Agricultural and Geographical Importance
agriculture.title: Agricultural and Geographical Importance
agriculture.description: The Sategaon region is known for its fertile land. Its progressive farmers cultivate various crops. Main Crops: Cotton, soybean, tur and wheat. Orchards: Orange and banana orchards are significant in this region, strengthening the village's economic condition.

administration.label: 📈 Rapid Development
administration.title: Rapid Development
administration.description: Sategaon has always been at the forefront of development. The village has a well-equipped Gram Panchayat building, concrete roads, good drinking water facilities and a wastewater management system (Drainage System).

development.label: Moving Ahead on the Path of Progress
development.title: Moving Ahead on the Path of Progress
development.description: The younger generation of the village is highly educated and works in various fields.
